settings.q: How soon will I notice a difference?
settings.a: Most owners see the first changes within the first week or two — less scooting, firmer stools and less paw licking. Gut health builds with daily use, so give it the full 90 days before you decide.

settings.q: How do I give the drops?
settings.a:
Once a day, added to food, based on your dog’s weight:

  • Under 10 lbs — 0.5 ml
  • 10–35 lbs — 1 ml
  • 35–75 lbs — 2 ml
  • Over 75 lbs — 3 ml

Each 60 ml bottle lasts about 60 days for a 10–35 lb dog, and less for larger dogs.

settings.q: Can I use it alongside other supplements?
settings.a: Yes. The drops are a daily food topper and can be given with other supplements. If your dog takes prescription medication, check with your vet before adding anything new.

settings.q: Is it suitable for puppies, seniors or pregnant dogs?
settings.a: It’s suitable for dogs from 12 weeks old, seniors included. It isn’t recommended for pregnant or nursing dogs, or for dogs with a tree-nut allergy, because the formula contains black walnut. If your dog has a health condition or takes medication, ask your vet first.
